title: doronicum papyraceum
intro: Doronicum papyraceum, commonly known as paper leaved leopard's bane, is a flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties that can aid in wound healing and reduce pain. The therapeutic actions of Doronicum papyraceum include its ability to lower blood pressure and act as a diuretic, making it useful for treating conditions such as hypertension and edema. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
